Premise (thread, main `fe753492`, `/mnt/project-files/build-seat1/35415/premise-read.md`): holds in part. The title is the process name and the page shows two time formats; the truncation was already fixed by #34588 (screenshot only); an "open record" link exists on the submitted-content card, but the title does not open the record; Approve is already the solid primary button, Reject is still solid red.
Basis: card #35415 (epic #34571).
Scope, the seat's reading:
1. The page header title is the business record's name (`record_title`, which the service already returns) and opens the record. When no record title can be read, the title stays the process name, so a bare record id never shows (the guarantee #24708 gave).
2. No separate subtitle: the highlight strip's "Process" cell already shows the process name once, which answers the card's complaint that it appeared twice. The card's item 1 asks for a subtitle; the seat reads its intent (the process name visible, once) as met and the PR body says so.
3. Reject uses the outlined danger style; Approve stays the solid primary button.
4. The approval timeline uses the header's compact time format, so the page has one format.
5. Not touched: the object's `nameField` and list titles.
Resume-from: none
Fold-or-serial: serial; no fold. #35983 (two-row record header, seat 5) also edits `containers.tsx` and `RecordDetailView.tsx`; this PR is written against main and merges main after #35983 lands. `overlap-check.mjs` before each push. L1 at L1-a. The PR carries `Fixes #35415`. The branch is the card thread's harness push branch, a measured platform exception to `claude/issue-<n>-<slug>`.
